rules: Preserve all returned rows, including non-significant and missing results.
Do not treat missing from the filtered cc file as biological absence or a null result.

Resting and activated samples are overlapping donors, not independent replication cohorts.
Dataset independence from published cohorts and model training must be audited separately.
Report p values as nominal; these targeted checks are not a new genome-wide discovery study.
